effect.name: GM Mesh Warp
effect.desc: A real control mesh. The layer is divided into a grid of vertices, a displacement field is evaluated at every vertex, and the field is then interpolated across each quad - so the warp has the structured, hand-shaped feel of a mesh deformation rather than the smear of a plain noise displace. Six fields: noise, wave, radial push, vortex, vector and ripple. Grid resolution, displacement amount, field scale, evolution, direction, a separate pinch/bulge at a movable control point, turbulence, mesh smoothing and clamp/mirror/wrap sampling are all independent.
